title: Remote UE Report completion by the UE

entities.name: REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE
entities.description: Message received by the UE indicating completion of the remote UE report procedure.

entities.name: Timer T3493
entities.description: Timer associated with the remote UE report procedure that is stopped upon receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.

entities.name: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
entities.description: State entered by the UE after stopping timer T3493 upon receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message.

relations.description: Receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message stops timer T3493.
Receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message causes the UE to enter the PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE state.
